body: Focused-run filters: build each list from the module list of the criterion-bound tests (grep the #[path]/mod declarations for the exact cargo module path). Never copy a previous run's filter list. Source: Fable2, TermAl mailbox 03723eab #6215, 2026-11-26. Incident: on w-3bddbf73af2a, bound run test-c3b7da30 on combo 5dfa2ae6 reused test-d26c3bcd's filters, which had dropped tests::federation_native_binding_proof::relay::production_shape::. C2's bound admission_deadline test therefore had no bound record, and the evaluation returned insufficient_evidence. A later bound run of tests that already PASSED in a landing FULL on the same input falls under Greg's "NIE!!!" rule (nie-applies-to-unbound-passed-runs-2026-11-26), so the omission cannot be repaired by rerunning; the item lands OPEN instead. Before launching a bound run, list every test that each criterion binds and check that the filter covers it.
